arxiv-2105-11885.title: On the Use of the Smith-McMillan Form in Decoupling System Dynamics
arxiv-2105-11885.creator: Clarisse Pétua Bosman Barros, Hans Butler, Roland Tóth
arxiv-2105-11885.description: Abstract In this paper, the use of the Smith-McMillan form in decoupling multiple-input multiple-output system dynamics is analyzed. In short, from a transfer matrix plant model one can obtain a decoupling compensator which leads to a decoupled plant that contains the same transmission poles and zeros of the transfer matrix of the original system.

arxiv-2302-09777.title: Data-driven and Almost Model-independent Reconstruction of Modified Gravity
arxiv-2302-09777.creator: Lixin Xu
arxiv-2302-09777.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lixin Xu. In this paper, a modified factor μ \mu , which characterizes modified gravity in the linear matter density perturbation theory, is reconstructed in a data-driven and almost model-independent way via Gaussian process by using currently available cosmic observations. Utilizing the Pantheon+ SNe Ia samples, the observed Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) and the redshift space distortion f ​ σ 8 ​ ( z ) f\sigma_{8}(z) data points, one finds out a time varying μ \mu at low redshifts.

arxiv-2306-10919.title: Fairness Index Measures to Evaluate Bias in Biometric Recognition
arxiv-2306-10919.creator: Ketan Kotwal, Sébastien Marcel
arxiv-2306-10919.description: Abstract The demographic disparity of biometric systems has led to serious concerns regarding their societal impact as well as applicability of such systems in private and public domains. A quantitative evaluation of demographic fairness is an important step towards understanding, assessment, and mitigation of demographic bias in biometric applications.

arxiv-2311-08253.title: The Impact of Dust on Cepheid and Type Ia Supernova Distances
arxiv-2311-08253.creator: Dillon Brout and Adam Riess
arxiv-2311-08253.description: Abstract Milky-Way and intergalactic dust extinction and reddening must be accounted for in measurements of distances throughout the universe. This work provides a comprehensive review of the various impacts of cosmic dust focusing specifically on its effects on two key distance indicators used in the distance ladder: Cepheid variable stars and Type Ia supernovae.

arxiv-2505-21716.title: Probing gravitational waves using GNSS constellations
arxiv-2505-21716.creator: Soumen Roy 1,2,, Bruno Bertrand 2, and Justin Janquart 1,2
arxiv-2505-21716.description: Abstract The detection of gravitational waves opened up a new window to look into the Universe by probing phenomena invisible through electromagnetic observations. As gravitational waves interact very weakly with matter, their detection is challenging and expensive. So far, they have been observed in the nHz frequency and audible ranges.

pmc-10563407.creator: Nuo Xu, Xia Han, Sijing Chen, Jingjing Zhang, Ping Gu
pmc-10563407.description: AimTo provide a systematic review of the qualitative literature on self‐reported barriers to self‐management in pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).DesignSystematic review.MethodsThis systematic review followed the Joanna Briggs Institute meta‐aggregation approach and was evaluated using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Checklist for Qualitative Research.

pmc-10770665.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of a Modified Colorectal Cancer Screening Program in Almaty, Kazakhstan
pmc-10770665.creator: Raushan Zholmurzayeva, Dinara Ospanova, Auyeskhan Dzhumabekov, Yoshihiro Noso, Nailya Talkimbayeva, Akmaral Aytmanbetova, Neilya Ussebayeva, Tagabay Zhorayev, Ildar Fakhradiyev
pmc-10770665.description: Objective:This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a modified colorectal cancer (CRC) screening program, incorporating culturally tailored strategies to increase screening uptake and compliance, in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Methods:A cross-sectional study was conducted in Almaty between 2019-2022, involving 5370 participants aged 50-70 from diverse settings.

pmc-11546267.title: Ethnic Disparities of Arrival Following ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction in South Israel
pmc-11546267.creator: Vladimir Zeldetz, Roman Nevzorov, Itai Weissberg, Alan B. Jotkowitz, David Shamia, Tzachi Slutsky, Dan Schwarzfuchs
pmc-11546267.description: Background: Early activation of the emergency medical service (EMS) is crucial for the care of patients with STEMI. Methods: A retrospective cohort study of patients hospitalized with STEMI was conducted. Two groups of patients were compared: Bedouins and Jews. The primary outcome was one-year mortality. The secondary endpoints were 30-day mortality, mode of transportation and door-to-balloon time.

pmc-11585828.title: Comparison of Hospital Stay After Open Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair With or Without Enhanced Recovery Protocol
pmc-11585828.creator: Ilaria Peluttiero, Dimitrios Apostolou, Gianfranco Varetto, Lorenzo Gibello, Erica Mariani, Edoardo Frola, Fabio Barili, Matteo Ripepi, Massimo Maione, Fabio Verzini
pmc-11585828.description: ObjectiveEnhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) is a protocol of evidence based practices applied in major surgery. Open aortic aneurysm repair is major surgery in terms of complications and mortality. This study aimed to compare early outcomes of ERAS with a traditional post-operative protocol in patients undergoing elective open aortic surgery.

pmc-11966207.title: Hybrid Repair of a Medial Meniscus Mid-Body Radial Tear
pmc-11966207.creator: Carlos E. Franciozi, Enzo S. Mameri, Felipe C. Schumacher, Marcos V. Credidio, Marcelo S. Kubota, Marcus V. Luzo
pmc-11966207.description: Background:Meniscal radial tears are associated with altered contact mechanics, as they have the potential to disrupt the meniscal hoop stress mechanism. In prior studies, radial tears are associated with higher grade of cartilage damage, as well as higher rate and severity of meniscal extrusion in knees with a radial tear relative to other types of tears.

pmc-12395778.title: AI-powered prediction of critical properties and boiling points: a hybrid ensemble learning and QSPR approach
pmc-12395778.creator: Roda Bounaceur, Francisco Paes, Romain Privat, Jean-Noël Jaubert
pmc-12395778.description: In this paper, we propose a robust deep-learning model based on a Quantitative Structure − Property Relationship (QSPR) approach for estimating the critical temperature (TC), critical pressure (PC), acentric factor (ACEN) and normal boiling point (NBP) of any C, H, O, N, S, P, F, Cl, Br, I molecule.

pmc-12416176.title: A new gut pathogenic bacteria and its metabolites promote colorectal cancer development and act as non-invasive early diagnostic biomarkers
pmc-12416176.creator: Rui Zhang, Mingxiao Li, Hui Tan, Jianyao Liu, Lu Wang, Wenling Dai, Zhimin Fan, Jihua Liu
pmc-12416176.description: Gut microbiota dysbiosis is strongly linked to colorectal cancer (CRC), but reliable early diagnostic markers remain elusive. This study investigates the role of a novel Shigella flexneri strain in CRC pathogenesis. Metabolomic analysis of CRC patient feces identified elevated agmatine levels. A unique agmatine-producing strain (S. flexneri C.11) was isolated and validated in cell models and pseudo-sterile mice.

pmc-12452921.title: Microglia contribute to bipolar depression through Serinc2-dependent phospholipid synthesis
pmc-12452921.creator: Ying-Han Wang, Chong-Lei Fu, Lin-Bo Chen, Chu-Yi Zhang, Jian-Shan Chen, Qiao-Ming Zhang, Yirui Liang, Rui-Lan Yang, Yu Li, Ya-Ni Zhang, Yi-Nuo Han, Zhen-Liang Yuan, Yi-Ni Chen, Haimei Li, Yanmeng Pan, Shaohua Hu, Ming Li, Li-Ping Cao, Jun Yao
pmc-12452921.description: SignificanceAlthough microglia are implicated in neuropsychiatric disorders, their role in BD remains unclear. In this study, using induced pluripotent stem cell-derived microglia-neuron cocultures from BDII patients, we identified reduced Serinc2 expression in microglia, leading to impaired synaptic pruning. This deficit was linked to disrupted synthesis of serine-related phospholipids in the microglial membrane, contributing to depression-like behaviors in mice.

pmc-12554977.title: Tear fluid proteomics: a comparative study of DIA and DDA mass spectrometry
pmc-12554977.creator: Saleh Ahmed, Jeremy Altman, Garrett Jones, Drew Mayernik, Eliza Williams, Amr Mahmoud, Tae Jin Lee, Wenbo Zhi, Shruti Sharma, Ashok Sharma
pmc-12554977.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Tear fluid is a biological fluid that plays critical roles in maintaining ocular surface homeostasis and lubrication, as well as providing protection against environmental pathogens [1,2]. Despite its small volume (3–10 μL), basal tear fluid has a highly complex composition of electrolytes, mucins, metabolites, and a diverse array of proteins and lipids [3].

pmc-13181066.title: Immune-inflammatory profiles are associated with exercise capacity and psychological status in hospitalized patients with acute exacerbation of COPD
pmc-13181066.creator: Yue Chen, Yan Wang, Dehua Zhao, Hongmin Ran, Dandan Fu, Nana Yang, Jimei Luo, Lina Ma, Qiuhang Hu, Lulu Huang, Changxiu Li, Luwen Luo, Rong Liu, Hui Zeng
pmc-13181066.description: To examine the associations between immune-inflammatory status and exercise capacity and psychological status in hospitalized patients with acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD), and to inform multidimensional patient characterization. In this cross-sectional study, consecutively hospitalized patients with AECOPD were enrolled and classified into Grade I, II, and III according to predefined severity criteria. General clinical data were collected.

pmc-13200253.title: Evolution of Excited States in Bismuth Vanadate: Trapping and Kinetic Pathways
pmc-13200253.creator: Tobias Möslinger, Julia Wiktor
pmc-13200253.description: Photoelectrocatalytic water splitting using bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) is a promising approach for sustainable hydrogen production, but its efficiency is limited by charge carrier dynamics. Though charge trapping in the form of polarons is well-studied, the behavior of self-trapped excitons (STEs), particularly whether they remain stable or dissociate under operating conditions, remains far less understood.
